## Added

- Claude now shows limit resets you can use with `/limit-reset`, with the date each one must be used by, when **Faster direct usage check** is on. **Settings → Providers → Claude → Reset credits** can notify you when a new reset arrives.

## Improvements

- Claude usage refreshes much faster with Claude Code 2.1.178 or later, and no longer starts your MCP servers each time. Older versions keep working as before.

## Fixes

- Claude shows model-specific weekly limits again, such as "Fable weekly". In 0.8.1 that card was missing even though Claude Code reported the limit.
- Claude limits now show the refreshed figures from Claude Code rather than the older values it displays first while it updates.
